name: Sonnet dividend growth and income
strategy: Anchor in quality dividend growers with AI-cycle exposure, add a tactical short against the most overextended leveraged momentum trade, use TLT for rate-cut convexity, and keep meaningful cash at 4% APY given stretched valuations after a huge H1 rally.

positions.thesis: Dividend grower with durable cash flows from Azure/AI infrastructure demand; quality compounder to anchor the book.
Dividend growth plus direct AI networking/custom silicon exposure; strong FCF supports continued payout hikes.
Diversified high-quality dividend growth ETF that lagged the AI-momentum rally, offering defensive ballast with income.
Best-in-class bank compounder with rising dividend, benefits from resilient economy and capital markets activity.
Energy dividend aristocrat providing sector diversification and inflation hedge with strong cash returns to shareholders.
Cyclical dividend grower positioned to benefit if small-cap/consumer breadth continues and rate cuts support housing turnover.
Long duration Treasuries offer income and convexity if growth cools into year-end after a huge risk-asset run, diversifying the equity income book.
3x semis ETF up +250% H1 into a visible AI-infrastructure correction over the last month; tactical short to fade an extended, leverage-fragile momentum trade.
BTC remains in a confirmed downtrend (-27% H1) with no reversal catalyst yet; small low-leverage short to monetize continuation while capping liquidation risk.
Defensive staples dividend payers that badly lagged H1's AI-led rally, offering mean-reversion income exposure and a hedge if the rally rotates defensive.

outlook: Expect continued but choppier gains into year-end as the AI trade digests its huge H1 run and rate-cut hopes support duration-sensitive dividend payers, while crypto remains structurally weak; positioning stays income-tilted with a modest tactical short overlay and ample cash for flexibility.
